newsitem.title: JAPAN: All Corp fears delay in collecting loans.
newsitem.headline: All Corp fears delay in collecting loans.

text.p: Japanese mortgage loan firm All Corp said on Monday there might be possible delays in collecting a total of 26.1 billion yen worth of loans it had extended to two real estate developers.

The Housing Loan Administration Corp, a body set up to collect problem loans run up by Japan's failed "jusen" mortgage firms, asked an Osaka court earlier this month to declare the two developers, including Sueno Kosan, bankrupt.
The loans to the two borrowers account for 15.5 percent of All Corp's total assets, the company said in a statement.
Nonetheless, All Corp said the impact of the loan repayment delays on the company's business was likely to be limited.
